title_sq: Tek Relux Residence, Shitet Apartament 2+1, Me Planimetri Dhe Orientim Ideal !!!
description_sq: Tek Relux Residence, Shitet Apartament 2+1, Me Planimetri dhe Orientim Ideal !!! title_en: At Relux Residence, 2+1 Apartment For Sale, With Ideal Layout And Orientation!!!
description_en: At Relux Residence, 2+1 Apartment For Sale, With Ideal Floor Plan and Orientation!!! The property is located on the 4th residential floor of a 5-story building and has a gross area of ​​99.5 m2, of which the net area is 88.4 m2. It is organized by a distribution corridor, a living room with a kitchenette, 2 bedrooms, a bathroom and 2 balconies. The orientation of the property is South-West. The selling price is 13,500,000 new Lek. Only 15 minutes from the center of Tirana, the location of the complex allows direct access to services such as: schools, hospitals, shopping centers, urban transport, etc. Currently, the building is in the stage of paving with tiles and will soon become habitable.
